description: Iraq - Major Roads Network is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by OCHA Iraq (inactive). This dataset contains the major roads network that connect all key locations in Iraq revisited by WFP Logistics Cluster during the period from 2015 - 2017. Coverage: Iraq. The portal files it under the publisher OCHA Iraq (inactive). Its tags are geodata, transportation. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2024-11-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
